song.title: What Child Is This (tune GREENSLEEVES)
song.composer: Traditional English (16th c.); words William Chatterton Dix (1865)

source.notes: SATB on two staves (upper = S+A, lower = T+B). Eighth-note pickup, 6/8. Voices are t1c0/t2c1 in this file. Source MIDI tempo is 60 qpm; overridden to 84 qpm (dotted quarter 56) for play.
